dct_description_sm: This project compared Moss-Aside (potassium salts of fatty acids – 22%) at two rates in comparison with the industry standard, Quicksilver (carfentrazone-ethyl – 224g A.I./L) on a putting green heavily populated with silvery thread moss (Bryum argenteum) and other common moss species (Bryum spp.). The study will provide information to the industry sponsor for use in the Canadian market.
